summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of PWA scan functionality for look-alike Zunagawa seal labels. Main bug (Kickstarter scan showing Versnelling) was NOT reproduced - all scans matched correctly with 100% accuracy across 6 repeated scans.

minor_issues.issue: OCR misread Versnelling part code ZGOSH53 as TFXFS5F
minor_issues.impact: Part code stored incorrectly but matching still worked via visual similarity and other text tokens
minor_issues.note: Tesseract OCR limitation with similar characters (G→T, O→F, etc). The matching engine compensates with visual embeddings and multiple text tokens.

minor_issues.issue: Scanning seal-shock.jpg matched to 'Kampas Rem Depan' instead of 'Seal Shock Depan'
minor_issues.impact: Sample item regression - may confuse users trying the demo

passed_tests: ✅ Photo-indexed scenario: Created Kickstarter and Versnelling items with photos
✅ Kickstarter scan: 3/3 scans correctly matched to 'Seal As Kickstarter'
✅ Versnelling scan: 3/3 scans correctly matched to 'Seal As Versnelling'
✅ Scan consistency: 100% consistent results across repeated scans
✅ Candidate list: Both items show the other as 20% match candidate (correct behavior for look-alikes)
✅ Evidence labels: Proper reasoning shown ('Kode cocok • Ukuran cocok • Foto mirip')
✅ Manual search: Search for 'ZGOSH12' correctly found Kickstarter item
✅ OCR auto-fill: Part codes and sizes auto-filled from photo labels
✅ Visual embeddings: MobileNet embeddings computed and used for matching
✅ Text matching: Token-based matching worked correctly
✅ Size matching: Size detection and matching (16x28x7 vs 11,6x22x7) worked
✅ Item creation: Both items saved with photos, embeddings, and OCR tokens
✅ Item list: Both items appear in the item list with correct details
✅ AI status: 'AI Offline siap' badge shown when models loaded

detailed_findings.main_bug_status: NOT REPRODUCED - The reported bug where scanning Kickstarter seal shows Versnelling item was not reproduced in testing. All scans matched correctly.
test_scenarios_not_completed: Typed-only scenario (items without photos) - blocked by UI interaction issue with size input
Chooser panel interaction - did not trigger ambiguous matches
Not-found flow 'Add as new' button - items were always matched
Learning from scan (picking candidates) - no ambiguous cases occurred

matching_engine_analysis.visual_matching: Working correctly - MobileNet embeddings distinguish the two similar labels
matching_engine_analysis.text_matching: Working correctly - OCR tokens and part codes used for matching
matching_engine_analysis.size_matching: Working correctly - Different sizes (16x28x7 vs 11,6x22x7) detected and used
matching_engine_analysis.evidence_tracking: Working correctly - Shows 'Kode cocok', 'Ukuran cocok', 'Foto mirip' appropriately
matching_engine_analysis.conflict_detection: Working correctly - Items with different codes/sizes don't conflict
matching_engine_analysis.candidate_ranking: Working correctly - Both items show each other as 20% match (appropriate for look-alikes)

ocr_accuracy.kickstarter: Excellent - ZGOSH12 read correctly, size 16x28x7 detected
ocr_accuracy.versnelling: Poor - ZGOSH53 misread as TFXFS5F (G→T, O→F, 5→S, 3→F substitutions)
ocr_accuracy.note: Despite OCR error, matching still worked due to visual embeddings and other text tokens

detailed_findings.user_bug_hypothesis: The user's reported bug may have occurred in a different scenario (e.g., items created without photos, or before the matching engine improvements). Current implementation correctly distinguishes the look-alike labels using multiple signals (visual, text, code, size).
